sodium.neoForgeBuildOnly: Fabricated's CI runs Sodium's Fabric build on NeoForge only, with the gaps docs/COMPATIBILITY.md lists; it isn't verified on this loader

notWithNeoForge.iris: Iris for NeoForge hooks classes of Sodium for NeoForge (its fluid renderer) that Sodium's Fabric build doesn't have

iris.neoForgeBuildOnly: Fabricated's CI runs Iris's Fabric build, with Sodium's, on NeoForge only, with the gaps docs/COMPATIBILITY.md lists; it isn't verified on this loader

essential-container.neoForgeBuildOnly: Essential's Fabric build is a loader that downloads Essential as the game starts; Fabricated loads what it downloaded from the next launch, and its CI runs that on NeoForge only, so it isn't verified on this loader
essential-container.suggestion: Use Essential's build for this loader if Essential offers one for this Minecraft version (essential.gg).

essential-loader.suggestion: Use Essential's build for this loader if Essential offers one for this Minecraft version (essential.gg).

wthit.neoForgeBuildOnly: WTHIT's Fabric build refuses to run on NeoForge: its own entrypoint throws when it finds Fancy Mod Loader (CI, run 357)

flashback.neoForgeBuildOnly: Flashback starts on the first registry freeze after the main initializers, where Fabricated holds NeoForge's freezes until then (REG-8); Fabricated's CI runs it on NeoForge only, so it isn't verified on this loader
flashback.suggestion: Remove Flashback: its Fabric build isn't verified on this loader.
